exposure: Twin pregnancies conceived via assisted reproductive techniques (ART)
outcome: Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 345 dichorionic, diamniotic twin pregnancies (207 spontaneous, 138 conceived via ART)
finding: Twin pregnancies conceived via ART were associated with a greater risk of placental abruption and patent ductus arteriosus compared to spontaneous twin pregnancies.
mod_finding: The study found no difference in mode of delivery between twin pregnancies conceived via assisted reproductive techniques and spontaneous twin pregnancies.
